narrative.overview: MOTEXA looks like a well-kept mechanic's job book: warm cream pages, espresso ink, and one copper accent used the way a mechanic uses a red pencil. It is a calm, trustworthy, warm system. Work happens on flat, hairline-ruled lists and quiet pages, not in stacks of boxes. Copper is rare enough that it always means "this is the thing to do" or "you are here".
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutrals only: cream, sand, espresso; copper is the single accent.
Flat by default; hairlines (1px) do the separating work.
Status is a colored dot plus a word, never color alone.
Cairo throughout (Latin and Arabic with no font change); extra-bold headlines, bold labels.
4px spacing grid, 44px touch targets, mobile-first (checked at 375, 768 and 1280).

rules.name: The Red-Pencil Rule
rules.body: Copper marks the one main action or the current place on a screen. If two things on a screen are copper-filled, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Status-Only Colors Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, red and blue are allowed for status indicators and nothing else. They never decorate headings, surfaces or buttons (danger buttons excepted).

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: No pure black, no cool grey. Every neutral leans toward brown.

rules.name: The No-Tiny-Grey Rule
rules.body: Muted text is 13px at the smallest and must keep AA contrast. Never shrink and fade text together.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Prices (ILS, ₪) and counts use tabular numerals so columns line up.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface gets a shadow only when it floats above the page (menu, modal, drawer) or responds to hover. Lists and settings sections never have one.

dos: Do build lists as flat hairline rows with a primary value, quiet metadata and a ••• menu for secondary actions.
Do use tokens (var(--color-*), --space-*, --radius-*); never raw colors or pixel sizes.
Do put dark brown (#1a1210) text on copper; white on copper fails AA.
Do pair every status color with a word.
Do keep muted text at 13px or larger with AA contrast, in both themes.
Do keep one primary button per view and let copper stay rare.
Do check light and dark mode at 375/390, 768 and 1280px.
donts: Don't nest cards or put every section in a box; use hairlines and whitespace (the flat variant) instead.
Don't use purple or blue gradient backgrounds.
Don't use tiny grey text; muted does not mean small and faint.
Don't use marketplace-style product cards on admin pages.
Don't use status colors (green, amber, red, muted blue) for anything but status indicators.
Don't use pure black or cool grey; dark mode is espresso brown.
Don't add shadows to resting surfaces, or glow to anything except the primary button.
